description: A single learner has been ability-estimated within an IRT calibration run. Captures the learner response vector for one learner per calibration run. irt_calibration_run groups all learners. Key = tid (immutable, unique).

calibrationRunId.description: Foreign key to irt_calibration_run. Format cal-{date}-{sequence}. Example: cal-2026-05-15-001

learnerDid.description: The learner whose ability was estimated. did:plc:... format.

abilityTheta.description: Ability on logit scale. Typical range [-3,+3]. At theta=b_i, P(correct)=0.50. Constraints: [-4, +4].

abilityStdError.description: Standard error of theta. Reflects response data quality.

responses.description: Learner response vector for all items in this calibration run.

itemId.description: Item identifier. Format dict:lemma:{id} or dict:pattern:{id}.

bI.description: Item difficulty b_i. Constraint b_i in [-4, +4].

pY1.description: Model-implied P(Y=1 | theta, a_i, b_i) = 1/(1+exp(-a_i*(theta-b_i))). For cross-validation: compare outcome vs pY1 to assess model fit.

calibratedAt.description: UTC timestamp when ability was estimated.

method.description: EAP = Expected A Posteriori (Bayesian, recommended; handles all-correct/all-incorrect) MLE = Maximum Likelihood Estimation (undefined for extreme response patterns) WLE = Warmly Weighted Likelihood Estimation (MLE with Fisher information weighting)

priorDistribution.description: Prior for ability in Bayesian estimation. normal = N(0, 1) standard normal (recommended for EAP). uniform = flat prior (used for MLE or non-Bayesian methods).

domain.description: Domain of calibration. null means general ability estimate. Domain-specific ability enables cross-domain transfer learning.
